Synopsis:
The dialog on the entrance to the extraplanar circus, where the player sees a ghoul sniffing entering customers - new measures because of the recent murders nearby. The player can pay an entrance fee and go and see the circus.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_Circus_Checkpoint.json: The player is standing at the gate of an extraplanar circus whose staff have instituted extra screening after a string of recent murders in the neighborhood. A ghoul attendant (Klaus in the sample) is being used to “sniff” entrants for blood/taint and will deny access to anyone who fails the check; normally an entrance fee can be paid to gain admittance. Off‑screen the city is tense—panic and violent incidents in the Lower City (and high‑profile conflicts involving figures like Gortash and Orin) have prompted venues to tighten security—so the circus’ new measures reflect that wider unrest. The example exchange shows the player being turned away after failing the sniff test and attempting to negotiate entry.
- WYR_Circus_GhoulSniffer.json: One-liner dialog for a circus ghoul, who sniffs customers entering the circus.
- WYR_Circus_EntranceGuard.json: One-liner dialog for a circus worker on the checkpoint after the player is allowed to enter. He has a friendly circus ghoul with him to check on the entering customers.
- WYR_Circus_EntranceCivilian.json: One-liner dialog for a citizen who just entered the circus. He is the civilian who is being sniffed by the ghoul as you enter the checkpoint scene.
- GOB_Checkpoint_Guard001.json: All guards at the checkpoint point the player to the guard with this dialog. He is an evil, nasty character who has no reason to go easy on the player. Should ooze disdain. This is the first goblin we meet and their weasly, cruel, wicked nature should stand out.
The goblin will let a non-allied player in only if they smear worg shit on their face. Yuck.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):

- Klaus: Now, now - you didn't pass the sniff test. Which means no circus for you - off you go! || [context] NodeContext: Dismissive shooing gesture - like to a dog. (player isn't allowed into the circus) (node 21)
- Player: Surely we can come to an agreement? ([GEN_CheckMagicPocketGold_6057ad05-9492-4630-9f0a-be548b134c54]) (node 120)

context: You’re at the gate of an extraplanar circus whose staff have added extra screening after a recent string of murders in the neighborhood. A ghoul attendant named Klaus is being used to “sniff” entrants for blood or taint and will refuse anyone who fails the check; ordinarily you can just pay the entrance fee to get in. The city is on edge—panic and violent incidents in the Lower City have prompted venues like the circus to tighten security. In the example exchange the player fails Klaus’s sniff test and is turned away, then attempts to negotiate entry; other checkpoint staff (including a nasty goblin guard) may be openly hostile in enforcing these rules.
